summary: Completed backend API and live frontend validation for logistics planning, analysis, maps, incidents, rerouting, and analytics.
action_items: Remove production-unsafe fallback defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; configuration should fail fast when missing.
Confirm Recharts bars render with visible fills in the deployed browser; the captured analytics screenshot showed axes/labels but bars were visually difficult to distinguish on the dark canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses localhost and logistics_db defaults for protected environment variables, contrary to fail-fast environment configuration requirements.
LogisticsContext.jsx and AnalyticsPage.jsx fall back to an empty backend URL, which can silently issue relative API requests outside the configured deployment URL.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST-prefixed critical Route B incident; the application also initialized its standard demo incidents in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested core flows passed. Recheck environment fail-fast changes and verify chart rendering visibility at deployment scale.
rca of the issue: The first UI script used an outdated close selector (btn-close-report-modal); source uses btn-close-incident-modal. This was a test fixture mismatch, not an application defect. Corrected the test selector and modal close plus submit/reroute flows passed.
